name: weather-brief
description: Current weather + 5-day forecast + air quality brief for a city or lat/lon, via OpenWeather over routed MPP through the SELAT Router. Returns current conditions, temperature, forecast, and AQI in one pass. Paid per call (USDC on Base), no API key.

lat.description: Latitude of the location, e.g. -6.2 for Jakarta. Used as ${lat}.

lon.description: Longitude of the location, e.g. 106.8 for Jakarta. Used as ${lon}.

steps.label: current weather — OpenWeather current-weather (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
5-day forecast — OpenWeather forecast-5day (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
air quality — OpenWeather air-quality (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
